# Once in a Blue Moon: Random Encounters

Because of the size of the Blue Devil and the Ogua, they will only spawn at certain Assault and Scene spawn locations that give them room to move and complete their animations.

The Blue Devil and Orgu will not spawn at Forest Regions' random encounter locations.
